name: cwl-clan-config-client
description: Cloudflare Pages frontend for the CWL clan-config Discord Activity. Plain TypeScript, no framework — see CWL_CLAN_CONFIG_ACTIVITY_PLAN.md for why.

scripts.deploy:dev: vite build --mode dev && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=cwl-clan-config-dev --branch=main
scripts.deploy:prod: vite build --mode prod && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=cwl-clan-config-prod --branch=main
